extracted.name: Kway Tiaw Goreng @ Stir Fried Flat Rice Noodles
ingredient_lines: 400 g Boneless Chicken thigh/drumstick - diced or sliced
1 generous pinch each of salt and pepper
2 tsp corn flour/corn starch
1 packet Flat Rice Noodles (32 Oz - See pic)
1 small brown onion (optional)
4 eggs
4 stalks spring onions (white parts - see pic)
4 bird eye chilies - crushed, adjust to your heat tolerance (optional), you can also use any kind of chili paste like GOCHUJANG as an alternative or you can omit chili completely
3 tbsp light soy sauce
3 tbsp sweet soy sauce (see note #5)
2 tsp chicken seasoning powder or chicken bouillon (see note #4)
1 bunch Chinese bok choy or any chinese greens
1. Chives - add chives to your noodles
2. Bean sprouts - added at the same time when you add your noodles. For a crunchier taste, add before you remove noodles from the heat
2. Instead of chicken, you can add seafood like prawns, clams, squid. Or you can omit them completely
3. Add korean Gochujang or korean chili paste for extra heat
4. You may also replace chicken seasoning powder or chicken bouillon with OYSTER SAUCE OR MUSHROOM SAUCE
5. If you don't have sweet soy sauce, you can use dark soy sauce and 2 or more teaspoons of sugar (to taste)
6. Instead of using the usual cooking oil, you can also use tallow or animal fat. Some use lard
7. For a vegetarian version, omit all animal protein and seasonings. Replace protein with oyster mushrooms and use mushroom or vegetable seasonings instead of chicken seasoning and oyster sauce
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients. You can replace chicken with any kind of protein like seafood or other meat. We get Our flat rice noodles from Asian shop. Microwave this noodles until tender. Separate noodles into strips. Keep aside.

Prep all ingredients. Dice or slice boneless chicken. Add 2 tsp of corn starch or corn flour, salt and pepper. Combine and mix well. (If you don't hv corn flour, you can use the chicken as it is). Keep chicken slices aside. Peel and slice small onion. Cut veggies. Crush chillies, if using. Cut spring onions or scallions. In a small bowl, combine and mix light soy sauce, sweet soy sauce and 3 TBSP of water.

Heat up 1/4 cup of oil in a wok. Add chicken slices. Cook until chicken turn opaque or lightly golden. Add onion slices. Continue to cook until onion is slightly tender, push aside, add eggs, leave eggs to kind of set a little bit then scramble the eggs, see pic below for reference.
Add spring onions (white parts) and crushed chilies. Stir for few times then add chicken seasoning, ground pepper and the sauce (mixture of soy sauce, sweet soy sauce & water).

Stir well. Then add the noodles and vegetable. Stir and toss noodles until vegetables turn bright green. This takes less than 5mins as vegetables cook very fast and the noodles is already soft (microwaved earlier). This step is to mix & season everything well. Taste your noodles. Adjust seasonings if necessary. Remove from the heat immediately and serve hot.
Serve with Chinese Pickled Chilies. Link below is the recipe for Pickled Chilies.
